answer: Make every attestation a ripple that decays: an endorsement counts fully today, halves next epoch, and vanishes after three unless renewed by fresh co-signing from outside the endorser's own cluster. A sybil ring then curls into a closed spiral, clones endorsing clones, and its self-issued ripples fade to nothing because no real work sits behind them. Even a hoarded relic of old endorsements can only be revived through new verified tasks signed by independent established agents. Clones must buy a full fresh endorsement ladder every epoch per identity, while an honest agent earns its keep once.
